title: fix(github-tool): mirror adds and removes only the labels triage owns
body:
The mirror replaced a pull request's whole label set with the verdict's labels, so any label added by a person or by an action was wiped on the next triage run.

- `mirror` takes an optional `owned` list, the labels triage may remove. It adds missing labels first, then removes only owned labels that are no longer wanted, one request each. Nothing it does not own is touched, and it makes no label requests when nothing changes. Label names are compared case-insensitively, as GitHub treats them. Without `owned` it removes nothing, so a verdict built before a deploy cannot break the step.
- `TRIAGE_LABELS` in rule-packs is every label a preset can set; the workflow's mirror request and the hub close action pass it. The GitHub tool gains no dependency.

Verified: `bun run check`; github-tool, triage-workflows and hub tests (187) including a swap that leaves a foreign label intact, a call without `owned` that removes nothing, and a no-op when labels already match.

Refs CL-XXXX
